# Copilot instructions

The single source of truth for this repository's agent instructions is [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. Follow it.

Skills live in [.agents/skills](../.agents/skills) and hooks in [.github/hooks](hooks).

Key reminders:

- Do not commit, push or create GitHub resources unless explicitly asked. Never change `--global` git config.
- Never read or print `.env`, and never ask for secrets in chat.
- Every brand's content is original: no translation across brands or languages.
- Run `npm run check` before declaring work done.
